requirement.original: "Stop hook feedback" blocks (e.g. "SPEC COVERAGE ENFORCEMENT: spec-verify.py reports < 100% coverage. …") currently render directly in the user-facing conversation view. Must be suppressed entirely — stop-hook output belongs in developer logs / internal telemetry only. Scope: all stop-hook feedback variants regardless of severity marker (✅/❌/⚠️) or script type (Python/shell/other). This is spec §5.9.
requirement.clarified: Any user JSONL message whose string content starts with "Stop hook feedback:" must be silently discarded in sessionProtocolMapper.ts by adding a prefix check in getSystemInjectedServiceText(). No envelope should be emitted; the message must not reach the app.
requirement.what: Silent suppression of all stop-hook output at the CLI mapper layer
requirement.why: Stop-hook feedback is an internal developer tool signal (e.g. timelock enforcement, spec coverage enforcement) that should never appear in the user's conversation view.

included: Any user message with string content starting with 'Stop hook feedback:'
All stop-hook script types: Python, shell, other
All severity markers: checkmark (✅), cross (❌), warning (⚠️)
excluded: happy-app render layer (no changes needed if CLI fix is correct)
Any message that does NOT start with the exact prefix

success_criteria: A user JSONL message with content starting with 'Stop hook feedback:' produces zero envelopes from mapClaudeLogMessageToSessionEnvelopes()
Regular user messages continue to produce exactly one user-text envelope
constraints: Change must be confined to getSystemInjectedServiceText() in sessionProtocolMapper.ts
Must use startsWith('Stop hook feedback:') — no regex needed
Must NOT emit a service envelope — silent drop (return null, not a string label)

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Stop-hook feedback text (e.g. 'Stop hook feedback: [python3 ...]: TIME-LOCK ACTIVE: ...') renders as a visible user bubble in the conversation view
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: getSystemInjectedServiceText() in sessionProtocolMapper.ts (lines 855-883) has no branch for the 'Stop hook feedback:' prefix. The function returns null (meaning: not a system-injected text), so the caller (lines 674-678) proceeds to emit a real user-text envelope containing the full hook output string.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — the 'Stop hook feedback:' prefix was never added to the suppression list; it is a missing case, not a regression.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The suppression list in getSystemInjectedServiceText() was built incrementally for known internal-protocol strings. Stop-hook output was not accounted for when the function was written.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Stop-hook output is developer-facing telemetry injected into the JSONL stream by the Claude Code CLI; it is not a real user utterance and should never appear in the conversation.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since the function was introduced; no regression involved.
